text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly holding through broad losses left my account down about 12% from Period 1, so I should review portfolio risk regularly rather than let inaction become my default.","Selling Stock B far below my average cost twice shows that my purchase price can anchor decisions; I should judge each position by its prospects from today onward.","Before trading, I should define position limits and decision rules so that any sale or hold reflects the portfolio’s overall plan, not the discomfort of realizing a loss."]}
